name: book_size_20pct_early_windows
written: 2026-10-16, after the 2018-2025 size grid (size_h5) and before any size test on the early windows
hypothesis: A TopkDropout book of 20% of the universe (n_drop scaled to keep n_drop/topk = 0.1) has a higher after-cost IR than the fixed top-50 book.
rule: Statistic: pooled IR difference (cross_universe.py, day-averaged excess over the two universes) and its paired block-bootstrap 90% interval. Confirmed if the pooled IR difference > 0 and positive in CSI500 (the universe where the book changes from 50 to 100 names; CSI300 changes only 50 -> 60); refuted if the pooled 90% interval lies below 0.
